capabilities: Pace a writing session against a words-per-hour ghost
Count words typed and deleted in any Markdown note
Show ahead, even, or behind status in a panel and the status bar
Resume an interrupted session when Obsidian reopens
Produce a session summary and callout after stopping
disambiguation: Not a Pomodoro or focus timer; it paces word output against a words-per-hour ghost rather than blocking time or managing distractions.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README states the plugin is fully offline with no network, telemetry, or account. Install instructions target development use (copying main.js, manifest.json, and styles.css manually).
problem: Obsidian's word count is a static total; it gives no feedback on whether your writing pace during a session is ahead or behind a target rate.
summary: Writing pacer that counts words typed during a session and compares your progress against a words-per-hour ghost pace.
